findings.message: The entry params listaId, responsavelId, prioridade, status, prazoDe, prazoAte, venceHoje and atrasada have effect filter:tarefasEquipe but no state holds them. Added one persisted public state per param (same id as the param), applied from URL/localStorage on entry and changed through the filters argument of listarTarefasEquipe.

The selectedTarefa state (entry.params.tarefaId) had no method to select. The request method obterTarefa(tarefaId | null) selects the task, persists the id and loads the record into tarefa; null clears it.

The command reatribuirTarefa has a typed input (responsavelId) but no <command>.input state. Added the public reatribuirTarefaDraft state with setReatribuirTarefaDraft, prefilled from the selected task and refilled from the record the command returns.

reatribuirTarefa and cancelarTarefa return a TarefaDetalhe, but the board rows are TarefaEquipeItem. The row is updated by id (status, owner, title, priority, due date, checklist progress) or removed when it no longer matches the active filters, but the row's venceHoje/atrasada indicators and the list name cannot be recomputed from the detail and stay as loaded (a cancelled task may keep its overdue mark until the list is reloaded).
